caption: Silk · three attachments · wind strength 3.4
alt: A coral woven cloth held by three gold attachment points and draping in front of a sphere and crate
steps: Choose the Three points pin arrangement.
Play for about 0.8 seconds, pause, and capture the simulated viewport.

caption: Canvas · full top edge pinned · surface pulled sideways
alt: A blue canvas sheet folded sideways by a pointer grab, revealing a solid sphere and crate behind it
steps: Choose Canvas material and Top edge attachments.
Play for about 0.8 seconds and pause.
Grab the cloth near the lower-left middle of the visible sheet and pull it upward and left.
Release and capture the actual deformed mesh.
